analysis.mode: CI-statistical fingerprint (PSNR invalid: impulse seed mismatch; wavelet sigma=0.0 is an artifact of sparse noise)
analysis.rationale: Single support pair (k=1). Residual target-clean: 90.00% of pixels exactly zero, remaining ~10% at exact 0/255 split ~5%/5% -> salt&pepper amount=0.10 = noise_impulse severity 5. Two independent simulation seeds reproduce all 10 content-independent metrics within 0.013% (impulse_total_pct diff 0.009%/0.003%, block_boundary, unique, overshoot, hf_lf all ~0); sev4 (amount 0.07) misfits impulse_total_pct by 30%. Zero residual on 90% of pixels excludes blur/JPEG/contrast (they would modify nearly all pixels); flagged variance_ratio=2.18, chroma_ratio=3.25, gm_ratio=5.33 are outlier-inflation false positives from the sparse 0/255 pixels. Noise step capped at UNCERTAIN per noise rules (seed mismatch).
analysis.cross_pair_validation: single support (k=1): no other pairs available; cannot cross-validate across support pairs
